evidence.reason: The finding asks that the signer boundary tests distinguish the non-root rejection from the oversized-frame rejection instead of both passing merely on a malformed-input exit code of 2. History contains commit 658a58234551d5a2a345ecdd4f3b790db9b29019, "fix(review): distinguish signer boundary rejection reasons", whose message directly matches this finding's requested change to the boundary rejection tests in apps/crq-python/test_signer_ledger.py. The anchored lines at tip are no longer the region described; the defect was addressed by that commit.
